title: Placement
description: auto: osu!/catch in the band left of the playfield (under the leaderboard; osu! has its own key counter on the right edge), taiko under the lane beneath the drum, mania beside the stage with the caps on the hit-position line. left / right: bottom of that screen side. below: under the playfield or lane. stage: beside the mania stage (uses Column start/width below).

title: Scroll direction
description: auto: right for osu!, taiko and catch (caps on the left, presses travel right), up for mania (caps below, presses rise like notes falling the other way).

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the overlay right (negative: left) from its zone, in 1920×1080 pixels.

title: Nudge Y / px
description: Moves the overlay down (negative: up) from its zone.

title: Scale
description: Overall size, 0.5–2.

title: Tape length / px
description: How far presses travel before they fade, 120–900.

title: Scroll speed / px per second
description: How fast presses travel along the tape, in pixels per real second (rate mods are compensated). 100–3000.

title: Lane width / px
description: Thickness of each key lane, 12–96. Narrowed automatically when many mania columns would not fit beside the stage.

title: Show press counts
description: Presses of this attempt under each key label.

title: Show keys per second
description: Live keys per second (presses in the last real second across all keys) and the attempt's peak.

title: Smoke lane (osu!)
description: Adds a lane for the osu! smoke key.

title: Bar colour
description: map: osu!, catch and mania bars take the tonal accent of the current map's background (taiko keeps don/kat colours). 18-lab: the colours below.

title: osu! colour
description: osu! K1/K2 bars (also the fallback when a map has no usable colour).

title: osu!taiko don colour
description: Centre (don) drum keys.

title: osu!taiko kat colour
description: Rim (kat) drum keys.

title: osu!catch colour
description: Dash (and move keys on osu!lazer).

title: osu!mania colour
description: All mania columns.

title: Mania column start (override)
description: 0 = read from the current skin's skin.ini through vosu. Otherwise skin ColumnStart (osu!stable, 480-line canvas; stable default 136); places the stage for the stage zone. Lazer centres the stage.

title: Mania column width (override)
description: 0 = from the skin. Otherwise skin ColumnWidth for every column (stable default 30).

title: Mania hit position (override)
description: 0 = from the skin. Otherwise skin HitPosition (480-line canvas; stable default 402). The caps sit on this line in the stage zone.

title: Backing
description: none: floats on the game (dark lane beds, a soft shade under the numbers). scrim: adds a soft shade that fades out around it. panel: a classic 18-LAB panel.
